Chooses what is left out of the picture of a camera before it is given to the GPU. `flags` is a set of bits: 1 turns on frustum culling (meshes that are completely outside of what the camera sees are not drawn at all), which is on by default. It is only an optimization and never changes the picture. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals leave this to Direct3D.

`CameraCulling camera, 0` draws everything, which is useful to measure what culling saves.
@param camera  Camera handle.
@param flags   1 = frustum culling (default). Other bits are ignored.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
PositionEntity camera, 0, 0, -10
cube = CreateCube()
PositionEntity cube, 100, 0, 0        ; Far outside of the view.
RenderWorld
Print TrisRendered()                  ; 0: not given to the GPU
CameraCulling camera, 0
RenderWorld
Print TrisRendered()                  ; 12: given to the GPU, which finds nothing to draw
```
